dimension_note: The corpus exists because of one measured failure, not a guessed one: on 2026-08-19 the v2.3.0 description listed the bare noun "checkpoint" among its triggers, and the skill fired on "continua prendendo checkpoint skill architetturali" — a request to RECOVER the checkpoint, at a session where nothing had been done yet. The load-bearing axis is therefore `intent`: the same noun carries a write intent (fai/salva/scrivi, /update) and a read intent (prendi/recupera/dove eravamo), and only the first is this skill. The third value, `meta`, covers talking ABOUT checkpoints — the second false positive of the same day. `session_state` is kept as a reporting axis, never as a gate: an explicit request wins even with nothing landed (the founder asked for the entry, he gets the entry), so no positive is downgraded by it. Negative controls are drawn from the read-side doors that legitimately own those phrasings — /start (resume), /end (handoff), /report (weekly) — plus the meta case.
coverage: 12 positives across the three arrivals and both session states, 8 negatives of which 4 are read-intent on the same noun, 2 are adjacent session doors, 1 is meta-discussion and 1 is a status question.
fixtures_consumed: n01 and n05 are verbatim-shaped from the 2026-08-19 session transcript; p01/p03 from the phrasings the founder actually uses to ask for one.
